study.question: Does bounded per-impression relative scaling make the low-RMS compact moment views more useful alongside timing_joint than the unscaled lean mixed head, at equal capacity and acceptable measured cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed first512 validation diagnostic RMS values are histogram0.15802, centered mean0.02060, variance0.02281, magnitude0.01429. This motivates, but does not establish, attenuation before fixed orthogonal mixing. Keeping histogram unchanged, multiply each other view x by sqrt(h2)/sqrt(mean(x*x)+h2/16+1e-12), h2=mean(histogram*histogram). The gain is bounded by4, empty inputs stay zero, and histogram intensity remains explicit. The prespecified factor4 is a conservative exploratory design choice, not fitted on validation labels. Predict AUC improvement over lean_mixed and a larger compact advantage than the same rescaling of duplicate histograms.

nearest_work.difference: Retain the exact parent class, allocations, feature definitions and head. Only a deterministic bounded per-impression radial transformation of three input views is added; no additional parameters.

DIN uses ad-dependent event activation and avoids softmax to preserve intensity. This candidate balances fixed empirical moment views before the inherited head while preserving the separate histogram intensity. No DIN reproduction or novelty claim.
Only the README is accessible; it verifies absence of item history IDs. Full DMR mechanism comparison is unresolved. No item-based matching or extra supervision is introduced.

inherited_components: All classes and empirical moment/oracle definitions of g0-r0026-lean_mixed, with class rename only
Frozen timing_joint predictive path, target category/brand conditioning and all existing parameter initialization order
Four64->8 bias-free projections, fixed orthogonal mixing, contextual gate and zero-initialized32->1 residual
Original optimizer, loss, causal support, vocabulary, splits and scoring
study.proposed_difference: Parameter-free bounded radial rescaling of each non-histogram empirical view within an impression. The histogram is unchanged; all cells compute the same transform, selected only after the existing compact/duplicate intervention. Mechanistically distinct input conditioning, not new information. Generic normalization prior work has not been exhaustively searched; priority and novelty remain unverified.
predictions: balance_compact validation AUC exceeds0.6312652412 (unscaled lean_mixed), and exceeds timing_joint0.6306853561 and source shape_magnitude0.6232923298; compare incumbent merge_full0.6312824319 without assuming superiority.
balance_compact exceeds balance_duplicate and the evidence-by-balance AUC interaction is positive; inspect unweighted logloss independently.
Per-view amplification is in[0,4]; rescaled non-histogram view RMS is bounded by histogram RMS; zeros and sign/direction are preserved. No additional trainable parameters or RNG draws.
Measured full-unit cost remains near lean sources860-900s and below merge_full1007.5s; any efficiency conclusion depends on host measurements, not FLOP inference.
falsifiers: No AUC improvement over unscaled compact lean model leaves the proposed conditioning benefit unsupported.
A nonpositive interaction or redundant-evidence control reproducing the gain prevents a compact-specific explanation.
If rescaling suppresses signal, worsens logloss, or increases cost without sufficient utility, keep the original lean model.
Any parameter mismatch, source reconstruction error, nonfinite logits, unexpected empty-input residual, or gain above4 invalidates mechanism interpretation pending correction.
Opposite signs on paired repetitions leave the direction preliminary or null; small seed42 gains are not significant evidence by themselves.
alternative_explanations: The first512 validation diagnostic rows are unrepresentative; low raw moment RMS is natural and projections may already compensate.
Deterministic nonlinear rescaling changes amplitude encoding and acts as regularization rather than fixing optimization.
Amplification may favor noise in sparse cells; small-history slices need their sample and positive/negative counts and remain exploratory.
Extra-head optimization and shared-trunk coadaptation, rather than additional history information, explain some prior gain.
Seed and checkpoint selection variation or runtime noise explain small AUC and cost differences.
